data.summary: Beispiel Energie AG confirms an electricity supply contract (tariff "Ökostrom Fix 12") starting 1 January 2026 with a 12-month initial term and a monthly advance payment of €78.00.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your new electricity contract. Supply begins on 1 January 2026 and the initial term is 12 months. You can cancel with one month's notice to the end of the initial term. After that the contract runs indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. You pay a monthly advance payment (Abschlag) of €78.00. The provider will handle the switch from your previous supplier. The app calculates the cancellation deadline from the contract terms. Keep the letter for your records.
